title: How should acceptance and artifact migration be sequenced without contradictory controls?
question: How should acceptance and artifact migration be sequenced without contradictory controls?
answer:
ACC-1: Reconcile ADR-000B/C/D to the locked answers, then accept them now without another owner reread. A confirmed grilling Question / Answer / Why / Impact readback locks the ADR; to-docs authors it before Specs and Tasks.
ACC-2: The accepted eight-file destination may lead the current seven-file implementation. ADR-000B names TASKBOARD.json; AGENTS and LEXICON distinguish accepted destination from installed files.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: ACC-1, ACC-2 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.
